plan.title: Group drama, and what you do

intake.question: In a group project, you're usually...

options.label: The one who keeps it fun
The one quietly doing the hard part
The one who presents it and shines

intake.question: If you had to be famous for one thing?

plan.speaker: yeon
plan.text: "The one with the plan." So you made the group project spreadsheet. With colour codes. Nobody asked.

mood.speaker: bom
mood.text: "The one who keeps it fun." Every group needs a mood maker. Without you, it's just homework.

quiet.speaker: bom
quiet.text: "Quietly doing the hard part." The member fans discover in year three and never shut up about.

shine.speaker: yeon
shine.text: "The one who presents it and shines." You did 10 percent of the work and 100 percent of the applause. Iconic.

unsaid.speaker: yeon
unsaid.text: You skipped your group project role. Which means it's either "did everything" or "did nothing". We'll find out.

voice.speaker: bom
voice.text: Famous for your voice. The member whose live vocals make the comments section go "CD swallowed".

moves.speaker: yeon
moves.text: Famous for your moves. So the fancam with eleven million views is yours. Humble about it? No.

look.speaker: yeon
look.text: Famous for your look. The airport photos alone have their own fan account.

words.speaker: bom
words.text: Famous for your words. The member who writes the lyrics, the captions, and the 2am fan letters back.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: No pick for the fame question. Fine. Fans will decide. They always do.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. You'd take the {pos_lower} spot and three others if the company let you.

Bom: You carry the group on bad days.

Yeon: You also correct the choreo in the group chat at 1am. Members have muted you. Lovingly.

Your growth arc: let someone else lead one stage this comeback. Watch what you learn from the side.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd lead the group, the fandom and the catering if allowed.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. You shine best inside the group, holding it together from the middle.

Yeon: Which is why you never ask for more lines. And then quietly sulk about the line distribution.

Bom: You're allowed to want a solo moment.

Ask for one thing this era: a line, a spot, a part. Out loud. Producers can't read minds either.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Ask for the line. You've earned the line.

wood.heading: Your stage energy: growth
wood.text:
Bom: Wood members get better in public. Fans can see the whole curve: the shaky debut, the confident third comeback.

Yeon: The "then vs now" compilation of you is a genre.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You grow in public. Fans love watching the curve.

fire.heading: Your stage energy: heat
fire.text:
Yeon: Fire members don't perform. They ignite. The ending fairy alone needs a content warning.

Bom: You give everything on stage. Save a little for after.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your ending fairy broke the internet. Twice.

earth.heading: Your stage energy: anchor
earth.text:
Bom: Earth members hold the formation together. When someone slips, you cover it before anyone notices.

Yeon: Fans call you "the stable one". In fancams, you're the one never off-beat.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're the reason the formation never falls apart.

metal.heading: Your stage energy: precision
metal.text:
Yeon: Metal members hit every mark. Sharp angles, clean lines, zero wasted movement.

Bom: Dance teachers use your practice videos as the example. That's respect.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your choreo is so clean it should be illegal.

water.heading: Your stage energy: flow
water.text:
Bom: Water members move like the music is coming from inside them. Fluid, unpredictable, hypnotic.

Yeon: You also forget the choreo and freestyle. Fans call it "artistry". The choreographer calls it something else.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't dance the song. You become it.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Not because you asked. Because when it all went wrong, everybody looked at you.

Bom: You speak for the group. You protect the younger ones.

Yeon: You also give the speech at every award show. Same speech. Fans can recite it.

Bom: Your real talent is making people feel safe enough to shine.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The tall pine. Of course they made you leader.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Leader energy. Also, unsolicited schedule-maker energy.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You stand up straight, you speak first, you take the blame when it goes wrong.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

open.title: You found the bathroom on day one and gave everyone directions.
open.text:
First day as a trainee. Nobody knows anything. You've already learned everyone's name, the schedule and the fastest route to the convenience store.

Bom: You're a natural {pos_lower}.

Yeon: You're a natural {pos_lower} and a natural "let me just fix that for you".
open.end: Yeon: Your position is obvious. What you're secretly famous for in the fandom is not. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Pine: you're not the flashiest. You're | the one every camera finds when the song hits the last chorus.

sample.text: Solo era concept: anthem. Big, upright, a song people sing at graduations. You'd cry at your own showcase.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Flexible, fluid, the one who makes a hard move look like breathing.

Bom: You're also the glue. You know who's upset before they do.

Yeon: And you've never asked for a centre spot. Not once. Even though you want it.

Bom: Your gift is grace. The kind that makes everyone around you look better.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The climbing flower. Graceful, flexible, the group's {pos_lower}.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You can do any concept. Your one weakness is saying what YOU want the concept to be.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You adapt to any concept. Cute, dark, retro. You make it look like you were born for it.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

open.title: You learned the choreo in an hour. Then pretended you hadn't, to be nice.
open.text:
Concept change? Easy. You can do soft, chic, girl crush or summer bop, and every version looks like the real you.

Bom: You're the most versatile one in the group.

Yeon: You're a chameleon with a fancam.
open.end: Yeon: Your position fits. The thing you secretly want from the group is on the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Flower: you blend in perfectly until | one eight-count where you don't, and that's the clip that goes viral.

sample.text: Solo era concept: the one where you finally pick a style and don't change it to fit anyone.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. When the camera cuts to the group, eyes go to you. Every time.

Bom: You make everyone feel part of the show. Fans and members.

Yeon: You also check the fancam view counts. Yours and everyone else's.

Bom: Your light is real. So is the tired version of you after the cameras go off.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The sun. Obviously {pos_lower}. Where else would they put you?

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: The camera finds you. Then it stays. Other members have noticed.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You light up a stadium. Fans in the back row feel like you're waving at them.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

open.title: You were born in the middle of the formation.
open.text:
Variety show, fan sign, music show, the vlog nobody planned. You're "on" in all of them. The camera loves you because you love it back.

Bom: You're a natural {pos_lower}.

Yeon: You're a natural {pos_lower}. You've also never once been fine with the side spot.
open.end: Yeon: Your position's obvious. What it costs you to be "on" all the time is the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Sun: you're unstoppable until | someone else gets the big moment. Then the smile is still there. The eyes aren't.

sample.text: Solo era concept: summer anthem, sold-out tour, one quiet ballad at the end that makes everyone cry. Including you.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Warm, intense, focused. You give the song its heart.

Bom: Fans feel like you're singing to them personally.

Yeon: You also rehearse one line forty times and still think it was flat. It wasn't flat.

Bom: Your devotion to the craft is your whole charm.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The candle. The {pos_lower}. The voice that makes a stadium go silent.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your bridge has its own fan cafe. With a weekly crying thread.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You sing like you mean every word. Because you do.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

open.title: You cried at your own high note. Live. On a music show.
open.text:
You're not the loudest member. You're the one who makes the arena go quiet with one line in the bridge.

Bom: Your voice is the emotional centre of the group.

Yeon: Your voice is a weapon of mass crying.
open.end: Yeon: Your position is clear. What you keep to yourself backstage is the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Candle: you don't move much. You | don't need to. One look at the camera and the clip has two million views by morning.

sample.text: Solo era concept: a ballad album written in one winter. No dance break. Just you and a piano and ruined mascara across the country.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Strong, steady, the sound underneath everything.

Bom: The other members trust you completely.

Yeon: You also take a month to warm up to new staff. The new manager thinks you hate them.

Bom: Your reliability is rare. Fans call you the group's safe place.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The mountain. The {pos_lower}. The voice the whole song stands on.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your expression range in music videos: neutral, slightly less neutral.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You hold the harmonies together. Without you, the song falls apart.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

open.title: Same face in every music video. Fans made it a meme. You don't get it.
open.text:
You're the steady one. On time, prepared, calm in a crisis. When the in-ear fails on live TV, you're the one who keeps singing.

Bom: You're the group's foundation.

Yeon: You're the group's foundation and also a little bit furniture. Lovingly.
open.end: Yeon: Your position's solid. Why fans love you more than you realise is the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Mountain: no flashy moves. Then | one smile at the end of the encore, and the fandom loses its entire mind.

sample.text: Solo era concept: warm R&B album, no gimmicks. People will call it "comfort music" and play it for a decade.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Good at all of it. Not the flashiest at any one thing, which you secretly mind.

Bom: You make everyone else's job easier.

Yeon: You also do your own job and everyone else's. On an empty stomach.

Bom: Your talent is range. Your challenge is picking one thing that's only yours.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The garden field. The {pos_lower}. Good at everything, takes care of everyone.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You're the one who remembers every staff member's name. And their kids' names.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You can sing, dance, rap a bit, and you remember everyone's allergies.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

open.title: You packed snacks for the group, the staff, and a fan outside.
open.text:
You're the member who can fill any gap. Main vocal sick? You cover. Dancer injured? You learn their part overnight.

Bom: You're the {pos_lower}. The group's safety net.

Yeon: You're the group's safety net, and nobody ever asks if the net is tired.
open.end: Yeon: Your position is everything. Your problem is the same. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Field: you're everywhere and | somehow nowhere on the fancam charts, because you're too busy covering everyone else.

sample.text: Solo era concept: the one where you finally do one thing, brilliantly, and let someone else bring the snacks.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Direct, intense, every verse lands like a punch.

Bom: Members feel safe knowing you've got their back.

Yeon: Fans also have a "times they said exactly what they thought" compilation. It's forty minutes long.

Bom: Your honesty is your brand. Your loyalty is your heart.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The sword. The {pos_lower}. Sharp verses, sharper stage presence.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: The company has a PR plan just for your interviews.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You protect the group. Hate comments about a member? You handle it.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

open.title: You told the producer the hook was weak. In front of the CEO.
open.text:
You say what everyone's thinking. In the practice room, in the studio, sometimes on live broadcast. The company has a whole PR plan just for you.

Bom: You're fiercely loyal to the members.

Yeon: You're fiercely loyal and you also once almost fought a sound engineer.
open.end: Yeon: Your position fits. The soft thing you'd never say on camera is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Sword: your verse hits so hard | the other members step back on purpose. Then you look at the youngest one and smile, and the fandom screams.

sample.text: Solo era concept: hard-hitting, self-written, one track that's secretly a love letter to the members.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Fans notice you first, in every photo, every stage.

Bom: You make the group look like art.

Yeon: You also read every comment about your face. Even the ones from 2019. Especially those.

Bom: Your beauty opens the door. Your talent is what keeps people.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The jewel. The {pos_lower}. Every photo is a magazine cover.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also asked for a retake on the airport photo. At the airport. From a fan.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Polished, precise, stunning. You make every concept look expensive.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

open.title: You asked a fan for a retake. At the airport.
open.text:
Fashion week invites. Brand deals. A fan account dedicated only to your hands. You look perfect, and you know exactly how much work goes into that.

Bom: You're the face of the group.

Yeon: You're the face of the group and the reason the stylist cries every comeback.
open.end: Yeon: Your position's beautiful. The pressure behind it is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: You on stage, Jewel: flawless angles, perfect | expression, until one tiny mistake and you replay it for a week while fans are busy loving it.

sample.text: Solo era concept: art film music video, minimalist styling, one raw live performance that shows what's under the polish.

base.your-position:
You're the {pos_lower}. Big ideas, big sound, a brain that never switches off.

Bom: The group's best songs started in your head.

Yeon: So did forty unfinished ones. There's a folder. It's called "maybe".

Bom: Your gift is vision. Finishing is the secret skill.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The ocean. The {pos_lower}. You hear the song before it exists.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your laptop has more unreleased songs than the company has release dates.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You make the music. Melodies, ideas, the sound of the whole era.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

open.title: 4am demo. Message: "thoughts???". Three question marks.
open.text:
You're the member with the laptop. Every era's sound started as a voice memo you recorded in a taxi.

Bom: You're the creative heart of the group.

Yeon: You're the creative heart of the group and the reason nobody in the dorm sleeps.
open.end: Yeon: Your position is the studio. Your problem is leaving it. Next page.
